blocks.text: You can connect your Databricks organization to Zscaler 3rd-Party App Governance to gain continuous visibility and governance for third-party apps installed in the Databricks environment.
A user with Account Admin privileges is required to connect 3rd-Party App Governance to your Databricks organization.
To connect your Databricks organization to 3rd-Party App Governance:

blocks.item: Click Connect in the upper-right corner of the App Dashboard.
From the drop-down menu, select Databricks.
(Optional) In the Add Integration window, enter the Tenant name.
Enter your Databricks Account ID. To learn how to locate your account ID, refer to the Databricks documentation.
Create an account-level service principal. To learn more, refer to the Databricks documentation.
Assign the Account Admin role to the service principal. To learn more, refer to the Databricks documentation.
Enter the Client ID and Client secret. To learn how to generate the client ID and client secret, refer to the Databricks documentation.
Click Connect to complete the integration.

blocks.text: Your Databricks organization is now connected. After a connection is achieved, it might take a while to pull and ingest all relevant application data depending on the size of your tenant. During this time, a message displays indicating that the tenant is still being processed. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the tenant details are updated on the Settings page. You then receive an email from Zscaler when the integration is ready for further review.
